owner_direction: Show both orderings to expose the tradeoffs
comparison_universe: the same selected 25 candidates in each lens; not an exhaustive global comparison
coverage_gaps: Major challengers needing deeper comparison include Tolstoy’s Anna Karenina, Dostoevsky, Kafka, Flaubert, Woolf, Borges collections, Manzoni, La Regenta, Indonesian works beyond Pramoedya, South Asian language traditions, Korean and Chinese modern fiction. Existing leads include Godaan, Tamas, Toji, Border Town and Love in a Fallen City. The pool is deliberately provisional; unselected candidates have not been defeated in a global comparison.
tradeoffs: Proust moves from 2 to 20: the recorded disagreement between immersion and abandonment matters much more in the reading scenario.
Ulysses moves from 5 to 25: a first-place Modern Library result remains intact as source evidence, while this draft tests a different reading priority.
Season of Migration to the North moves from 13 to 3. Arabic criticism and rereading testimony help justify investigating this rise; they do not establish a consensus third place.
